person MEET THE FOUNDER

I didn't get lucky.
I got strategic.

My name is Lyndon Bedford. I'm a U.S. Army Iraq Veteran (2001-2005). Like many of you, I struggled with the VA system for years before I finally cracked the code to getting the benefits I earned.

Lyndon Bedford

U.S. Army, 2001–2005 • Iraq Veteran

Why I Filed Differently

For years, I followed the conventional wisdom. I filled out the forms, I went to the exams, and I waited. And for years, I was either denied or given a rating that didn't reflect my reality.

I realized the system isn't "broken"—it's a bureaucratic machine that runs on specific types of evidence and language. When I shifted my focus to combat-related PTSD and documented my symptoms honestly using the VA's own 38 CFR rules, everything changed.

The Timeline

  • 1

    Phase 1: Strategy

    Re-evaluating my medical records and aligning symptoms with 38 CFR criteria.

  • 2

    Phase 2: Evidence

    Gathering buddy statements and clarifying medical documentation.

  • 3

    Outcome: 100% P&T

    Just over 1 year from the new strategy to a life-changing decision.

Pay It Forward

I created this site and the guide because I know how frustrating it is to feel ignored by the department that's supposed to help you. My mission is to give you the tools I wish I had on day one.
